JUVENILE PERIODONTITIS
Introduction
An uncommon disease characterized by periodontal destruction, often in the
absence of overt gingival inflammation
Epidemiology
- Prevalence 1:1000; male = female
- Onset at puberty or earlier
Clinical Features
- Affects the first permanent molar and incisors
- Actinobacillus, Actinomycetes comitans has been isolated from the affected
sites


- Results in drifting and loss of the first permanent molar and incisors
Investigation
- Radiology may reveal marked bone loss interdentally, inter-radicularly and
apically
